items.summary: arXiv:2412.16655v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper we derive a new direct inversion method to simulate squared Bessel processes. Since the transition probability of these processes can be represented by a non-central chi-square distribution, we construct an efficient and accurate algorithm to simulate non-central chi-square variables. items.title: Disclosure under Noisy Information Processing

source.name: Jeremy Bertomeu, Edwige Cheynel, Peicong Hu

items.summary: arXiv:2609.07898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Capital markets process disclosures with noise. Adding this single friction overturns the standard characterization of costly voluntary disclosure. Firms may unravel to full disclosure despite strictly positive disclosure costs and, when unravelling fails, the model generically admits two equilibria rather than one.
